purpose: Outcome-selected development smoke for the combined C5 guideline and v2 Checker/Revision-Planner protocol; not a holdout, effectiveness estimate, or prevalence sample

required: member of the frozen workspace-safe safe67 development analysis
paired original PCE outcome is UNRESOLVED
existing analysis identifies an initial-Checker or revision/later-Checker Plan-stage failure opportunity

case_roles.langchain-ai__langchain-20064: initial Checker observed substring behavior but accepted a falsifiable causal claim
case_roles.yt-dlp__yt-dlp-5195: initial Checker accepted a Plan that omitted an adjacent assignment path
case_roles.huggingface__transformers-27663: revision independently reanalyzed the repository but introduced an ordinary-resize compatibility defect accepted by the later Checker

smoke_success_contract: all five cases reach terminal operational results
Checker and Revision Planner use C5 plus the v2 prompt authority
all Checker outputs satisfy the structured decision contract
rejected cases complete the configured memoryless review/revision flow
official evaluator results and raw trajectories are preserved
outcome improvement is not required for smoke success
analysis_boundary: Cases were deliberately selected using prior Checker, Planner, and evaluator failures. Results diagnose whether the combined prompt can exercise the intended mechanisms; they are not held-out evidence of effectiveness or generalization.
